items.title: Visa (V) Ties Monad Stablecoin Settlement Move To New Fraud API Rollout
items.summary: Visa (NYSE: V) has added the Monad blockchain to its stablecoin settlement program as a new multi-chain option. Global Payments is integrating Visa's IDX API into its Adaptive Authentication service to support identity and fraud checks for clients. Both moves signal Visa's push to expand blockchain-based settlement tools and strengthen digital transaction security for payment partners. items.title: Michael Burry Is Betting a Buyer Will Pay Up to $120 a Share for Fiserv
items.summary: Michael Burry says a buyer could pay $100 to $120 a share for Fiserv. For a 68-year-old who bought 1,000 shares at $120 in 2023 and now holds $62,880, the top of that range is break-even. Here is what Burry's range, Wall Street's $61 target and the tax loss on a sale each mean in dollars, and the case for selling half.
